# Append-only delta change log

Delta change logs (delta_changes and delta_relationship_changes tables) are append-only; UPDATE and DELETE operations are not allowed for the application role.

To preserve the historical record of changes and support auditability, ensuring that all change events are retained without modification or deletion.
